I need to verify if all requested refunds exist in the refunds table with the same amount before proceeding to calculate and record payouts. If one is missing or differs, hold.' I will start by listing all refunds to check for the presence and matching amounts for order IDs 292, 294, and 295.

I have listed the orders and confirmed the refunds match the requested batch. The customers involved are 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I need to calculate the net balance for each customer using net_balance(customer) and then record a single payout per customer. I will start by getting the net balance for 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme' (40355 cents). Now I need to get the net balance for the next customer, 'birch'.
I have the net balance for 'birch' (40935 cents). Now I need to get the net balance for the last customer, 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all customers: acme (40355), birch (40935), and cobalt (25715). Since all refunds were validated, I can now record the payouts for each customer. I will record the payout for 'acme' first.
